t: You're at the Moravian Burial Ground, the burial ground of the Moravian Congregation in London. Buried here is James Ridgway, who died in 1838. He was a publisher and bookseller in Piccadilly and St James's Square, and he printed political pamphlets, later by radical authors and members of the London Corresponding Society. In 1793 he was charged with seditious libel for publishing the second half of Thomas Paine's Rights of Man, and he spent four years in Newgate prison. After his release in 1797 he kept publishing until his death.
